newsitem.title: USA: Theragenics files for 2 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Theragenics files for 2 mln shr offering.

text.p: Theragenics Corp Friday said it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration statement for two million shares of common stock to be offered by the company to the public.

It also registered an additional 300,000 shares of common stock subject to an over-allotment option to be granted to the underwriters. The offering will be co-managed by Smith Barney Inc and Dain Bosworth Inc.
Theragenics, based in Norcross, Ga., is the maker of TheraSeed, a rice-sized device used in the treatment of localized prostate cancer with a one-time, minimally invasive procedure.
